system.description:
You're a member of law enforcement, such as a beat cop, detective, or perhaps a lawyer or judge. You made a career of the law at one point. Perhaps you still do.

Qualities

Assign a d10 and a d8 to two of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.JbpF0zq2JHhwxVHD]{Close Combat}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.zlx2bULfYfooNB03]{Criminal Underworld Info}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.Zd02ZFDoMvEL1WWZ]{Ranged Combat}

• Select from Mental qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Principle

Choose a Responsibility principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d8, d6 for power source selection.
